description: This Java interface defines a contract for generating and handling entity tags (ETags) related to commands and entities within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It provides methods to determine previous and next entity tags for versioning, as well as appending ETag headers to responses based on entities.

classes.name: ETagEntityProvider
classes.description: Generic interface for entities that provide ETag values based on commands and entity states, allowing for optimistic concurrency control and cache validation in a system using Eclipse Ditto.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Determines the entity tag that was associated with the entity before a command was executed, which can be used for validation purposes.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Generates the latest entity tag after a command modifies the entity, for cache validation or concurrency control.

methods.name: appendETagHeaderIfProvided
methods.description: Appends an ETag header to the provided headers if the entity provides one, facilitating HTTP caching mechanisms.
